_comment: Provenance pin for the one file in this slug copied from the authors' release: their reduced
model on the on-off protocol, from S1 Code of the article. It is vendored byte-identical under
reference/; check_author_file.py refuses to run if its sha256 differs from the value below.
Everything else in the slug is written here. VERIFY: sha256(file bytes) == sha256.
publication: Jaruszewicz-Blonska J, Kosiuk I, Prus W, Lipniacki T (2023). A plausible identifiable model of the canonical NF-kB signaling pathway. PLoS ONE 18(6):e0286416. doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0286416 (PMC10237389)

publisher_copy.item: S1 Code of the article, pone.0286416.s015.zip

license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
license.applies_via: S1 Code, published as supporting information of the open-access PLoS ONE article
license.attribution: Jaruszewicz-Blonska J, Kosiuk I, Prus W, Lipniacki T (2023), PLoS ONE 18:e0286416, S1 Code.
license.changes: None. The file is moved out of its archive folder and given an upstream_ prefix; its bytes are unmodified (including trailing whitespace).

reference/upstream_fitted_reduced_model_.role: The authors' reduced 2023 model at the Table 1 fitted values, with its own actions block: the on-off protocol of Table 2 (TR = 0 for 0-3600 s, TR = 1 for 3600-10800 s, TR = 0 to 46800 s) for WT cells and, with c_deg = 0, for A20KO cells. The README of S1 Code says this file produces S6 Fig (WT).

S1_Codes/BNGL files/Lipniacki_et_al_2004.used_for: The fit target: the .exp files of this slug are its raw on-off output at the Table 2 times (VALIDATION.md, Gate 1). Not needed by check_author_file.py.
